title: 特別活動の指導法（夏期集中講義）
subtitle: Teaching Methods for Special Activities
teachers:
TAKAHASHI Tomomi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Problem behaviors of students are increasing now. In response to this situation, the expectation for extracurricular activity is growing. “Desirable group activity” is a keyword in extracurricular activity, classroom activities are especially important. In this course, students study historical change and theory of extracurricular activity. In addition, teacher's practical teaching skill for club activity and classroom activity is considered.
advice:
This course covers the items as below:
 (1) The objectives and contents of extracurricular activity found in the course of study
 (2) The historical change of postwar extracurricular activity
 (3) The students’ situation and teacher’s practical teaching skill
 (4) The guidance of club activities
 (5) The practice of extracurricular activity focusing on classroom activities
books: Eriko Harada, Tomomi Takahashi, & Ken-ichi Moriyama(2019) Saishin Tokubetu-Katsudou-Ron(revised edition), Daigaku-Kyouiku Shuppan.
requiredKnowledge:
●It is important to remember the experience in secondary education for understanding and considering extracurricular activities.
●Aiming to obtain Japanese teacher's license.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the course of study on extracurricular activity.
Be able to state an opinion about the better extracurricular activities suitable for traits of puberty.
Be able to explain the educational significance of club activities.
Be able to make a plan of classroom activities with understanding the function of classroom.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the Central Education Council Report and the course of study of extracurricular activities correctly.
(2) State an opinion about the better extracurricular activities suitable for traits of puberty.
(3) Understand the position of club activities and club activities in the curriculum accurately.
(4) Understand the function of the home room and plan the practice of the homeroom from a practical viewpoint.
